senses.gloss: m. (preced.) divination from birds, augury. Pesik. Par. p. 33ᵇ שהיו יודעים במזל וערומים בט׳ they understood astrology and were shrewd in augury; (Pesik. R. s. 14, v. אַסְטְרוֹלוֹגְיָא); Tanḥ. Ḥuck. 6; ed. Bub. 11; Koh. R. to VII, 23 קוסמין בעופות ובקיאין בט׳ divined from birds and were experts in divination.—Pl. טְיָירִין (טְיָארִין, טִיאוּרִין); חכמת הט׳ the art of divination.
units: <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:23">Ib.</cite> to X, 20 (ref. to <cite ref="P00311"><he>עוף</he></cite> ib.) <he>זה הוא העורב בח׳ ט׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>חכמת טיאריו</he>, read <he>בח׳ … ין</he>) that means, the raven (carries the sound) through the art of divination; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7">Midr. Till. to Ps. VII</cite>, beg. <he>וח׳ טיארין</he>; Yalk. Koh. 979 <he>העורב ח׳ טיאורין …</he> (read <he>בח׳</he>); <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32">Lev. R. s. 32</cite> <he>וח׳ טייארין</he>.
